checked_results.finding: Complete nontruncated 42-entry tree; wheel and tar match source Git blobs. Five nested tar layers and associated wheels contain source/build/code/notebook/timing material. All eight unique notebook byte versions across 19 occurrences were inspected; saved outputs are logs, shapes, Matplotlib text and PNG images, with no serialized coefficient array or notebook attachment. Numeric literals are plot orientation tuples and a multipole-axis list, not T/E/B values.

Each is finite float64 shape (249,). Source figure notebook cells 43-50 explicitly forms elapsed time_end minus time_start, saves these files, and labels Time (s). These values are timing measurements, not multipoles.

Complete nontruncated 314-entry tree. Four downloaded numeric candidates match Git blobs and have two or three columns. P(k) table is a primordial spectrum input; psd_FD_single is a phase-space input; selection/evolution tables have input-table structure. Other listed DAT families are recombination/BBN/heating/distortion resources, not a deterministic polarized atlas. The Bianchi notebook stores maps as rendered PNG outputs and array lengths, not alms.

Four ZIP sizes and provider MD5 values match. All 33 PDFs parse as posterior/triangle plots and have zero embedded files. All 17 chain TXT files parse: 260572 total rows, 20 columns each. Provider metadata identifies MC chains and posterior plots; no ell,m,T,E,B member or convention-linked polarized map payload appears.
The cached authoritative record lists four MP4 files only. This review does not claim inspection of video bytes and does not infer universal absence from that record.

Complete 68-entry tree. Both 204480-byte FITS match source Git blobs. Each has a single simulation column, 48 rows of 1024 floats, NSIDE 64 RING, and no Q/U or E/B columns/HDUs. Source README identifies temperature-only VIIh simulations. Their T values cannot provide missing polarization.

physical_domain_assessment.IX: The closed IX branch fills only the first ell channel of the T/E/B integration arrays. The internal ell_max=3 enables storage/padding; it does not supply ell=3 morphology. In the canonical tensor frame the nonzero support is ell=2 with |m|=2; rotations can populate all m at ell=2.
physical_domain_assessment.all_m: Complete canonical-mode support with justified reality/rotation completion is sufficient within the declared domain. A literal dense file for every m is not required when absent canonical m values are justified exact symmetry zeros. Unprovided E/B channels are never symmetry zeros by default.
physical_domain_assessment.restricted_admission: One declared family/mode/background/ell domain may support a conditional external-transfer comparison. All families, irregular modes and a native atlas are not prerequisites for that restricted comparison; unsupported domains remain UNKNOWN.
physical_domain_assessment.units_frame: No numeric unit or frame conversion was performed. Metric (-,+,+,+) and explicit c remain project conventions, not proof that external data use identical conventions.

metadata_necessity_assessment.necessity: Hard missing input now. Require source-identified coefficients or sufficient-resolution numerical T plus Q/U maps (or equivalent numerical T/E/B maps), with all requested channels represented.

metadata_necessity_assessment.necessity: Necessary for a convention-sensitive physical comparison. Source documentation already specifies parts of the conventions; the missing object is a complete, verified binding to an actual numerical payload, not universal absence of convention information.

metadata_necessity_assessment.necessity: Bind the declared physical transfer to resolvable producer release/configuration and assumptions. Existing sufficient source/configuration provenance can satisfy this; separate full history arrays and repeated solver execution are not blanket requirements.

Required when claiming a calibrated physical shear amplitude. A declared normalized morphology-only comparison can remain conditional on source amplitude normalization without pretending that physical conversion is known.
State the actual smoothing and frame; an unsmoothed source template can legitimately declare no beam. Do not require an instrument receipt for a theoretical unsmoothed product.

Qualification checks after a candidate payload exists. Their absence does not prevent safe acquisition/inspection of a new source-identified candidate, and they should not be made an upstream delivery prerequisite by circular reading of missing_input.
